s00.text: አሥራ ሁለተኛ ክፍልን እንደጨረስኩ ባሕር ዳር ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተመደብኩ፤ ያኔውኑ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ተጀመረ።
s00.subtitle: When I finished twelfth grade, I was assigned to Bahir Dar University; right then a new chapter began.

subtitle_check.literal: As soon as I finished twelfth grade, I was assigned to Bahir Dar University; right then a new chapter began.

s01.text: ጉዞዬ የተጀመረው ከአንኮበር ነው፤ አንድ የጀርባ ቦርሳ እና በጥያቄ የተሞላ ሐሳብ ብቻ ይዤ።
s01.subtitle: My journey began in Ankober; with only one backpack and a mind full of questions.

subtitle_check.literal: My journey began from Ankober, carrying only one backpack and a mind filled with questions.

s02.text: መጀመሪያ ወደ ደብረ ብርሃን፣ ቀጥሎ ወደ አዲስ አበባ፣ በመጨረሻም ወደ ባሕር ዳር።
s02.subtitle: First to Debre Birhan, then to Addis Ababa, and finally to Bahir Dar.

subtitle_check.literal: First to Debre Birhan, next to Addis Ababa, and finally to Bahir Dar.

s03.text: በመስኮት ስመለከት መንገዱና መልክአ ምድሩ እየተቀያየረ ሄደ፤ ደንና ተራሮች፣ ሸለቆዎች እና የሚዘረጉ መንገዶች።
s03.subtitle: As I looked out of the window, the road and the landscape kept changing; forest and mountains, valleys and roads stretching away.

subtitle_check.literal: As I looked through the window, the road and the landscape kept changing; forest and mountains, valleys and stretching roads.

s04.text: አውቶቡስ ተራ ስደርስ አመሻሽ ነበር፤ ጓደኛዬ እዚያው ተቀበለኝ።
s04.subtitle: It was dusk when I reached Autobus Tera; my friend met me there.

subtitle_check.literal: When I arrived at Autobus Tera it was dusk; my friend met me right there.

s05.text: ሰው በየአቅጣጫው ይንቀሳቀሳል፣ መኪኖች ያልፋሉ፣ ደላሎችም «አልጋ ትፈልጋላችሁ?» እያሉ ይጠይቃሉ።
s05.subtitle: People move every way, cars pass, and brokers ask, "Do you want a bed?"

subtitle_check.literal: People move in every direction, cars pass by, and brokers ask, saying, "Do you want a bed?"

s06.text: ለአፍታ ሁሉም ነገር በአንድ ጊዜ የበዛና ግራ የሚያጋባ መሰለኝ።
s06.subtitle: For a moment everything seemed too much at once, and confusing.

subtitle_check.literal: For a moment, it seemed to me that everything was too much all at once and confusing.

s07.text: በመጨረሻ ባለ አንድ አልጋ ክፍል መረጥን፤ በጣም ምርጥ አልነበረም፣ መጥፎም አልነበረም—ግን ለማረፍ የሚበቃ ንጹሕ ነበር።
s07.subtitle: In the end we chose a room with one bed; it was not the best, and not bad, but clean enough to rest.

subtitle_check.literal: In the end we chose a one-bed room; it was not the very best, and it was not bad either, but it was clean enough to rest.

s08.text: በማግስቱ ጠዋት ጉዞውን ለመቀጠል ረጅም ሰልፍ ተሰልፈን ትኬት ቆረጥን።
s08.subtitle: Next morning, to continue the journey, we stood in a long queue and bought a ticket.

subtitle_check.literal: The next morning, to continue the journey, we lined up in a long queue and bought tickets.

s09.text: ያንን ከቤት የወጣሁበትን የመጀመሪያ ሌሊት ሳስታውስ፣ ከተለመደው ዓለም ወጥቶ አዲስ ጉዞ ለሚጀምር ሁሉ የምለው አንድ ነገር አለ፦ የመጀመሪያው ሌሊት ሁሌም ግራ ያጋባል። አትሸሽ። አጣጥመው።
s09.subtitle: When I remember that first night away from home, I say one thing to all who leave the familiar world and start a new journey: the first night is always confusing. Do not run. Savour it.

subtitle_check.literal: When I remember that first night I left home, there is one thing I say to everyone who leaves the familiar world and begins a new journey: the first night is always confusing. Do not flee. Savour it.
